name: TACTICSBRID
source:
You are Akiyama Ryuunosuke Sho-i (2nd Lt.), newly assigned CO of the 701st Experimental Powermover Company, an elite Mecha force of the United World Government, which is in a total war against icon gaza. In your new position you not only need to command your 7-mecha sized group in highly tactical battles, but also earn the respect (and potentially more) of your all-female comrades.

[From Backup1723]
